metadata.axes: X nose-positive, Y up, Z starboard-positive
metadata.source: User-supplied Marinha do Brasil photographs of AH-11B Super Lynx (N-4003 and sister aircraft); scale anchors from published Lynx HMA.8/Super Lynx data
metadata.precision: Dimensional anchors in metres; contours traced from perspective photographs, not a millimetre-certified engineering model
metadata.configuration: N-4003, BERP four-blade main rotor parked, port four-blade tail rotor, wheels down, rescue hoist, chin radar and FLIR; no external weapons as photographed
metadata.webCopy: positions rounded to 0.1 mm, normals to 1e-3
